# We want to capture the segments being rendered
# console.print(panel) doesn't return them.

class SegmentCaptureConsole(Console):
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.captured_segments = []

    def render_line(self, line):
        self.captured_segments.extend(line)
        super().render_line(line)
